newsitem.title: USA: Springs sees Q2 earnings below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Springs sees Q2 earnings below estimates.

text.p: Springs Industries Inc said on Wednesday that it expects its second quarter earnings per share to be about $0.80, which would be $0.02 higher than the year-ago period, but would fall short of Wall Street analysts' expectations.
The First Call consensus estimate for Springs' quarter ending June 28 was $0.89 per share. The company's shares were down 2-11/16 to 50-7/8 in early trading.
Springs said in a news release that its expected $0.80 per share earnings would be before unusual items, which it did not specify.
The company said earnings in its home furnishings segment would be up 25 percent. But it said its specialty fabrics segment encountered significantly weaker market demand in certain areas.
Springs also said that its year-ago results included earnings from its Clark-Schwebel industrial fabrics business, which was sold in April 1996.
Springs said it will report final results next week.
